  • Plan and execute high-speed imaging campaigns for mechanism analysis (firearms cycling, feeding, extraction) and ballistic pattern capture (projectile trajectory relative to aerial targets)

  • Design test setups including camera positioning, field of view, working distance, and trigger architecture

  • Select operating parameters — frame rate, resolution, exposure time, pre-trigger buffer — appropriate to each test objective

  • Configure and operate Photron Fastcam and Phantom high-speed camera systems

  • Design and implement trigger circuits from TTL sources including pressure sensors, acoustic triggers, and hardware fire signals

  • Set up and qualify lighting rigs for high-speed scientific imaging, including continuous LED systems at short exposures

  • Perform on-the-spot data quality assessment immediately after capture — identify whether footage is scientifically usable before proceeding to next shot

Quantitative Analysis

  • Extract kinematic data (displacement, velocity, acceleration vs. time) from high-speed footage using PFA, ProAnalyst, or equivalent motion analysis software

  • Calibrate pixel-to-physical-unit conversions and apply appropriate lens distortion corrections

  • Propagate measurement uncertainty through to reported kinematic quantities; characterize what the data can and cannot support

  • Produce clear, actionable reports communicating findings to mechanical engineers and program leads — not footage, but data with stated confidence

  • Maintain test records, data files, and calibration documentation consistent with a defensible engineering record

Instrumental & Data Acquisition

  • Design and build test fixtures and instrumentation setups supporting high-speed imaging campaigns

  • Integrate supplementary sensors (pressure, acoustic, accelerometers) with camera trigger and timing systems

  • Own data acquisition hardware selection, setup, and operation for test programs

  • Support broader test program infrastructure as the team and test scope grow

Test Program Ownership (Growth)

  • Develop and maintain test plans, procedures, and data reduction protocols

  • Drive test campaign planning from requirements to execution to results delivery

  • Build out and maintain the team's high-speed camera infrastructure as equipment is procured

  • Evaluate candidate cameras during rental evaluation sessions and provide procurement recommendations

Requirements

  • B.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, or related technical discipline

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience operating scientific high-speed cameras (Photron Fastcam, Phantom, or equivalent) in a test or research environment

  • Demonstrated experience extracting quantitative kinematic data from high-speed footage — velocity, acceleration, displacement — not just producing video

  • Proficiency with motion analysis software: PFA (Photron FASTCAM Analysis), ProAnalyst (Xcitex), or equivalent

  • Experience designing and implementing external trigger systems for ballistic or mechanical test events

  • Practical understanding of lighting for high-speed scientific imaging — exposure times, continuous vs. pulsed sources, avoiding flicker artifacts

  • Ability to assess data quality in the field and make real-time setup adjustments to recover a test session

  • Familiarity with data acquisition systems and multi-channel sensor integration

  • Experience in a ballistics, weapons systems, or terminal effects test environment (government range, defense contractor, or national lab)

  • Background in test fixture design and fabrication

  • Experience with Schlieren or shadowgraph imaging for ballistic diagnostics

  • Active Secret clearance or ability to obtain one

  • M.S. in a relevant engineering or physics discipline

  • Passion for building robots or engineering projects as a hobby.

If you want to see your code or hardware in the field next month—not next year—this is your playground.

Position Summary

We are seeking a Field Applications Engineer (Demo Engineer) to serve as the critical bridge between our engineering lab and real-world deployment. You will be the hands-on expert responsible for bringing our autonomous c-sUAS platforms to life in front of active-duty end users, government partners, and key stakeholders.

From flashing software builds and calibrating multi-sensor payloads in the lab to operating systems and troubleshooting hardware live on the test range, you ensure zero-fail execution when the pressure is on.

Essential Duties

  • Demo Operations & Execution: Lead live, dynamic flight and target-tracking demonstrations in field environments, operating autonomous counter-drone systems flawlessly under high-stakes conditions.

  • System Preparation & Hardware Setup: Prepare, assemble, and check complex autonomous hardware and edge-compute systems prior to field tests and customer demonstrations.

  • On-Site & Field Calibration: Perform precise hardware and sensor alignment, including boresighting, thermal/EO camera focusing, lens calibration, and multi-sensor orientation.

  • Software Deployment & Validation: Flash latest software builds, test system stability, perform integration tests, and ensure firmware/software readiness for field trials.

  • Rapid Field Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve unexpected hardware, software, networking, and sensor issues on the fly with minimal downtime during field trials.

  • Feedback Loop: Serve as the direct link between field reality and R&D, capturing detailed telemetry, edge cases, and user feedback to inform engineering rapid iteration cycles.

  • Linux Shell & Networking: Highly comfortable working in a Linux shell environment with a strong understanding of TCP/IP networking, routing, and system diagnostics.

Requirements

  • Hands-on Field/Demo Experience: Demonstrated experience deploying, operating, or troubleshooting complex hardware/software systems in real-world or live-fire test range environments.

  • Technical Calibration Skills: Practical experience with optical/camera calibration (focus, boresighting), sensor alignment, and field validation techniques.

  • System Administration & Tooling: Proficient in Linux CLI environments, firmware/software flashing tools, and basic networking/telemetry debugging.

  • Hardware & Electronics Proficiency: Experience with harness assembly, field repair, cable building, and multimeters/oscilloscopes for quick edge-side hardware fixes.

  • Travel & Physical Requirements: Willingness to travel to outdoor testing sites and demonstration ranges; comfortable working outdoors in varying terrain and weather conditions.

  • Compliance: This position requires access to export-controlled information under ITAR. Only U.S. citizens are permitted. Must be willing to submit a background check.

Nice-to-Have

  • Prior experience with robotics, Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS), counter-UAS (c-UAS), or defense range operations.

  • Familiarity with thermal/IR optics, RF sensors, or embedded Linux environments (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson).

  • Prior defense startup experience or military background in range safety/flight test operations.

  • Security clearance or the ability to obtain one.

  • A passion for building or engineering robotics or electronics as a hobby.

Benefits

  • Meaningful Early Equity: You aren't just an employee; you are a foundational owner. Your contributions directly drive the value of your stake in the company.

  • Direct Roadmap Influence: Forget the bureaucracy of big defense. You will have a seat at the table, directly shaping our product and technology trajectory from day one.

  • Mission-Critical Work: We don't build for "what if." We build systems the Department of War actively needs to counter immediate, real-world threats.

  • The Builder's Playground: Work in a brand-new lab fully optimized for rapid prototyping, equipped with NVIDIA Jetsons, high-end scopes, and 3-D printers.

  • 100% Employer-Paid Premiums: We cover 100% of your medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums and cover 50% of healthcare premiums for your dependents.

  • Unlimited PTO: We value results, not clock-watching. Take the time you need to stay sharp and recharge.

  • Zero Red Tape: You report to the founders. You have the autonomy to make technical decisions that would take months of committee approval at a larger firm.

Occasional travel for vendor visits, supplier audits, and industry events.

Only U.S. citizens are permitted. Must be willing to submit a background check. 9 Mothers is hiring an Integration Engineer to connect our counter-drone platform with the broader ecosystem of systems our customers already run. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain integrations between our product and third-party enterprise and mission systems—most notably Command and Control (C2) platforms—so that our detection, tracking, and defeat capabilities plug cleanly into a customer's existing operational picture.

You will own the full integration lifecycle: understanding partner and customer system interfaces, defining data and messaging contracts, building and testing the integration, and supporting it through deployment in the field. This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, systems integration, and customer-facing technical work in a fast-moving defense startup environment.

Essential Duties

  • C2 & Third-Party Platform Integration: Design, build, and maintain integrations between our counter-drone system and external platforms, including Command and Control (C2) systems, sensor networks, and other mission systems used by our customers and partners.

  • API & Interface Development: Develop and maintain APIs, data feeds, and messaging interfaces (REST, SOAP, pub/sub, and similar) that expose our system's detection, tracking, and status data to external platforms in a reliable, low-latency manner.

  • Protocol & Standards Work: Implement and troubleshoot military and industry-standard data formats and messaging protocols (e.g., Cursor-on-Target, Link 16, VMF, TAK/ATAK, or comparable interoperability standards) as required by customer and partner systems.

  • Requirements & Interface Definition: Work directly with customers, partners, and internal engineering teams to gather integration requirements, define interface control documents (ICDs), and translate operational needs into technical specifications.

  • Testing & Validation: Build and execute integration test plans, including simulation and hardware-in-the-loop testing, to verify correctness, timing, and reliability of data exchange between systems before and during field deployment.

  • Field & Customer Support: Support integration efforts during customer demonstrations, pilots, and field deployments, troubleshooting issues across the full stack—from our system, through the network, to the receiving platform.

  • Documentation: Produce and maintain clear integration documentation, interface specifications, and runbooks for internal teams and external partners.

Requirements

  • Integration Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience as an integration engineer, systems integration engineer, or similar role, integrating software products with external enterprise systems.

  • Enterprise Integration Fundamentals: Strong working knowledge of APIs (REST/SOAP), messaging and pub/sub systems, data serialization formats (JSON, XML, Protobuf), and general middleware/integration patterns.

  • Programming & Tooling: Proficient in at least one modern programming language commonly used for integration work (e.g., Python, Kotlin, C++, or C#), with the ability to read and write production-quality integration code.

  • Military C2 Experience: Direct experience integrating with Command and Control (C2) systems or other military mission systems, including familiarity with formats/protocols such as Cursor-on-Target, Link 16, VMF, STANAG (4586, TDL, etc), or TAK/ATAK

  • Development Environment Experience: Familiarity with Android Studio (for ATAK development) and Visual Studio (for Windows-based C2 integration)

  • Defense Industry Background: Experience working in a regulated, ITAR, CMMC, or compliance-bound defense environment, or prior experience at a defense contractor or with DoD customers
